verdict.rationale: The README documents a setup step for entering your own model endpoint and key, stored in the Keychain. It states that any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works, including vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and cloud APIs, and the app lists the endpoint's models, accepts a manual model ID and lets you set separate planner and actor models. Missing for 10: support for non-OpenAI-compatible ("or otherwise") protocols, and independent or hands-on confirmation that custom endpoints work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point the agent at my own model endpoint (OpenAI-compatible or otherwise) through documented configuration

citations.quote: Any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works (vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama, cloud APIs).
Give Me a Brain — enter your model endpoint and key (stored in the Keychain)
The app lists the endpoint's models for you to choose one explicitly; you can also enter a model ID, and set a separate planner and actor model.
